desired_change.text: Build a custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open that runs on NVIDIA DGX Spark, taking the attached System Ontology files as the statement of what is wanted.

requested_result.text: Deliver the engine as a reproducible container, with a clean rebuild, benchmark report and replayable run artifacts.

in_scope.text: Custom inference for Meta Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA DGX Spark.
Provide text input and text output.
The target specification proposes reporting time to first token, decode rate excluding the first token, and peak memory; their workloads remain undefined.

out_of_scope.text: The operating system and other processes are outside the proposed container memory accounting boundary.
Model loading is excluded from the proposed time-to-first-token measurement.

constraints.text: Container packaging, a reproducible container, a clean rebuild, a benchmark report and replayable run artifacts are required.
Text is the required input modality and the required output modality.

The proposed pass/fail memory budget is 80 decimal GB in mem0. Its proposed accounting boundary includes everything the engine container holds in the unified pool at any moment: CPU and GPU process allocations and page cache attributable to files it reads. The budget choice, unit basis and accounting boundary require confirmation. The specification distinguishes this budget from nominal machine memory, reported allocatable memory and the cited GPU working-set figure.

The proposed quality baseline is the published reference implementation with NVFP4 weights, the published tokenizer and greedy sampling. The proposed comparison requires the same output tokens as that baseline if computation changes are forbidden; otherwise it requires a task score not below a threshold. The task set, threshold and permission for output-changing transformations remain unset.

Proposed time-to-first-token timing begins when the engine admits the request and ends when it produces the first output token. Proposed decode-rate reporting excludes the first token. Proposed peak-memory reporting uses mem0 and the same accounting boundary as the proposed memory budget.
Execution, state, composition, policy and binding are explicitly left open to the factory.

user_targets.target_text: Proposed pass/fail budget of 80 decimal GB in unified memory pool mem0, subject to confirmation of the budget, unit basis and container accounting boundary.

uncertainties.description: The offered context length for the engine's pass/fail contract is unset. The model's maximum context does not specify the context the engine must offer.

uncertainties.description: The memory budget, decimal unit basis and container accounting boundary are explicitly proposals awaiting confirmation.
uncertainties.clarification: Confirm or replace the proposed 80 decimal GB budget and its accounting boundary.

uncertainties.description: Permission for quantisation below NVFP4 or approximations that change output is unset, leaving the applicable quality-comparison branch unresolved.

uncertainties.description: The quality baseline and comparison are proposed, while the held-out task set and pass threshold are unset. If output-changing computation is allowed, the task-score pass criterion cannot yet be judged.
uncertainties.clarification: Confirm or replace the proposed baseline and comparison; identify the task set and, if task-score comparison applies, its metric and pass threshold.
